minutes_text:
INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES –October 26, 2022

The Inglewood Library Board met on October 26, 2022 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 4:32 p.m. by
Vice Chairman Julie Minton.

Roll Call

Present:
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member

Staff:
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Cochran made a motion for the approval of the minutes for August 24, 2022.
  Board Member Douglas seconded the motion.

  All in favor, motion passed.

Board discussion items

  Due to Thanksgiving and Christmas Holidays, board members discussed the Holiday schedule.
  Board Member Cochran made a motion for Board Members to have a Special Meeting on November 30,
2022 at 4:30 pm and to suspend the December regular Board Meeting until January 2023. Board Member Minton
seconded the motion.

  All in favor, motion passed.

  1
 Library Report

  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo provided the board members with a library update that included the Library
hours, user reaction forms that are available on every public desk at both libraries; and the commendations that we
get from the public are put in the section of our newsletter; tutoring; class visits; Halloween decorations; programs;
pumpkin carvings with 150 pumpkins in both libraries; partnership with Parks and Recreation Department outreach
with 500 visitors; picture taking and games that involved giving away treats; partnered with A T & T and hosted
computer classes offering basic skills in English and Spanish and received completion certificates; ordering new
books for all ages and different subjects in all areas and divisions; hiring of new librarians and clerks; 2 internships;
$27,000 in grants that were received for programming.
  Board member Douglas asked if grant money was allocated to the Library from the State for hiring.
  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo answered no.
  Board member Cochran was very happy with the newsletter. She stated that it is very attractive and
engaging, anyone can find something for themselves at any age or stage.

  Board member Douglas stated that it is mobile device friendly, easy to use and very interactive.

  Board member Minton wished that the Library website can be as user friendly as the Newsletter.

  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo explained that Library website is new and the library is actively working on
making it user friendly and attractive.

  Board member Minton asked about updates on the renovations.

  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that there are no updates on the Main Library and gave an update on
the Morningside and Crenshaw Library.

  Board member Julie Minton asked questions about the bonds for the Main Library.

  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo told the board members that Harjinder Singh is the project manager and will
provide answers from him.

  Board member Douglas ask questions about tutoring.

  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo give them an update.

Friends Report

  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) gave an update on getting
donations from community. They continue to get donations from community and are looking for ways to convert
them to dollars; connecting with Antiquarian booksellers association for them to buy books from FOIPL. Sue Carleo
thanked everyone for ongoing support.

Public Comments

  None
  2
 Commissioner Comments

  Board members Cochran and Douglas commended Kerri and staff for doing a wonderful job.

  Board member Minton stated that she’s resigning from the board, enjoyed serving and November will be
her last meeting.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 5:19 p.m.
